sources.games: 288 league games since 7.40 (7.41 alone had under 300) (data/heroes/item_stats), win 54.9%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py naga_siren.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Bloodthorn, Orchid Malevolence, Silver Edge.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-19: Eye of Skadi against heavy healing (it is in the build). no Black King Bar for a magic lineup alone (audit).

rules.name: Bloodthorn

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: silence them with {item}, for 5 seconds your attacks and your illusions' attacks on them never miss
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: заглушіть ціль через {item} — 5 секунд ваші атаки й атаки ваших ілюзій по ній не промахуються

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Bloodthorn, Soul Rend: silences for 5 s and gives True Strike to your attacks and your controlled units' attacks on the silenced target; Pierce: 40% of attacks pierce evasion. It is in her build (Orchid at ~17 min); Monkey King Bar works on her attacks only, not on her illusions'. High-rank Nagas against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 55% of 29 games against them (52% otherwise), won 69% against 38%.

rules.name: Eye of Skadi

reason.en: {enemy} heals a lot: your {item} halves their health restoration, so keep it in the build
reason.uk: {enemy} багато лікується: ваш {item} удвічі ріже відновлення здоров'я, тож не пропускайте його

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eye of Skadi: attacks cut health restoration by 50% for 3 s (+35 all attributes, the slow). It is in the build (34% of the won games, ~30 min); high-rank Nagas against heavy healers: 21% of 33 games against them (27% otherwise), won 57% against 54%. The player review: Skadi against healing for every carry who has it in the build.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: wraith_band 56% (2), magic_wand 41% (4), power_treads 87% (6), yasha 87% (11), manta 87% (14), oblivion_staff 82% (16), orchid 82% (18), heart 67% (24), butterfly 56% (28), bloodthorn 59% (28), skadi 34% (30), aghanims_shard 33% (36).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 20:00 13000 (51 games, 86.3%), 25:00 18000 (54 games, 85.2%), 30:00 23500 (50 games, 86.0%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

suppress.illusions: Mirror Image gives her 3 illusions and Rip Tide (Valve 7.41f) hits every enemy within 300 with her and her illusions' attacks. High-rank Naga Siren players do not buy Maelstrom against illusion heroes (22 games: it is not among the items they buy more often there).
suppress.magic: Black King Bar is not in her build; high-rank Nagas against 3+ magic damage heroes: 14% of 22 games against them (13% otherwise), won 33% against 58%. BKB still comes after two deaths under stuns (situational_items.py).

skills.basis: 288 games: maxed naga_siren_mirror_image > naga_siren_rip_tide > naga_siren_ensnare 230 (win 57.8%), naga_siren_deluge > naga_siren_mirror_image > naga_siren_ensnare 25 (win 60.0%), naga_siren_deluge > naga_siren_mirror_image 11 (win 18.2%); talents 10: Rip Tide Damage 280/286 (55.7%), Reel In Pull Speed 6/286 (33.3%); 15: Mirror Image Damage 156/254 (62.2%), Mirror Image Illusion Damage Taken 98/254 (55.1%); 20: Mirror Image Illusion 146/156 (69.9%), Song of the Siren Cooldown 10/156 (80.0%); 25: Mirror Image Cooldown 39/45 (79.5%), +25 Agility 6/45 (83.3%).
